pmc-10518708.title: An automatic immuno-microfluidic system integrating electrospun polystyrene microfibrous reactors for rapid detection of salivary cortisol
pmc-10518708.creator: Yecan Wang, Hiroshi Murakami, Toshihiro Kasama, Shigenobu Mitsuzawa, Satoru Shinkawa, Ryo Miyake, Madoka Takai
pmc-10518708.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). SummaryConventional competitive enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay (ELISA) to measure the cortisol level in body fluid consumes a large amount of time, owing to complicated operations involved and requirement for precise control of reagent addition. We developed an automatic microfluidic system to detect salivary cortisol rapidly, and an electrospun polystyrene (PS) microfiber-based reactor providing considerable binding sites for antibody immobilization, thus resolving the time limitations of competitive ELISA.
